scope: Original generated functional and assembly concepts; not Birdland SKU drawings, full BOMs, dimensions or specifications.

references.caption: srPruner
references.review: Cutting blade and counterblade, separate frames and grips, pivot, adjustment segment, distinct closure catch, flat-strip volute return spring and closing cushion. Hidden hardware stays within assembled groups. Earlier exploded drafts rejected for inconsistent frames/spring and missing stop/lock. Generic external functional map, not a tracing or quantity-complete FELCO drawing.

references.caption: srTrowel
references.review: Complete scoop/tang group enters whole opaque receiving grip; separate transverse hand-tightened screw. No invented axial pin or disassembled grip internals. Manufacturer drawing endpoint returns no-drawing placeholder; product description and published replacement grip/screw are the evidence.

references.caption: srRake

sources.title: Sneeboer · handle replacement / adhesive and rivet

references.review: Head/socket remains one group; wood shaft joins directly, transverse rivet and adhesive contact. No separate adapter. Tine count, head geometry and wood appearance are generic; reference dimensions are not transferred.

references.caption: srSprinkler
references.review: Oscillating tube, two-rail base and opaque drive housing retained. Separate service examples match listed filter 00964-00.640.00, connector 00991-00.720.00, O-ring 01550-00.000.11, needle 02082-00.620.07 and O-ring 18300-00.600.16. Housing is closed; no invented gears or turbine. Manufacturer diagram endpoint returns no-drawing placeholder. Service groups are not a full BOM.

references.caption: srPackaging
references.review: One backing card, one complete tool and one formed shell with flange sealed to the card. Seal is an interface, not a loose gasket. Hang slot outside cavity. Optional ties, trays and cartons in planning list are alternatives and transport layers, not mandatory parts of this retail example. No recycled-content or certification claim.
